revisionNote: Pre-release revision 3 (2026-09-27). Added Emitter Size and Velocity Spread (M3-01). Revision 2 had split Velocity into three scalar sliders and added Emitter Origin as a 3D point, because AE point controls are position controls delivering layer pixels. No release has been published, so IDs are still being shaped here; they freeze at the first shared release (ADR 0001). New controls are appended with new IDs; AE parameter grouping arrives in M3-03.

parameters.label: Emitter Origin
parameters.note: AE position control with comp-view picking. The registered 50/50/50 default uses AE's centre convention; checked-out values are normalized by the adapter to layer-centred world units. A compatibility shim remains until the current 13-control build is read back in AE 2023.

parameters.label: Velocity Y
parameters.note: Positive moves up. The 0.3 default keeps a freshly applied instance visibly alive instead of showing one static dot.

parameters.label: Velocity Z
parameters.note: Positive moves toward the viewer. Reserved for depth; the 2D compositor ignores it.

parameters.label: Particle Size
parameters.note: Sprite diameter in full-resolution layer pixels.

parameters.label: Emitter Size
parameters.note: Cube edge length for Box, diameter for Sphere and Disc. Ignored by the Point emitter.

parameters.label: Velocity Spread
parameters.note: Independent uniform jitter applied to each particle's velocity per axis. Without it every particle behaves identically and a steady emitter looks frozen, because births keep replacing the particles that leave; this is also what makes Random Seed visible.

compatibility.idPolicy: Released numeric IDs are permanent; never renumber or reuse. IDs are still being shaped until the first shared release.
compatibility.migrationPolicy: Add IDs for new controls. Removed controls become hidden compatibility parameters when old project data needs them.
